description: This Java class `AutowiredCredentialsManagementAdapter` is a Spring Boot component that acts as an adapter between the `CredentialsManagementService` and its event bus implementation. It uses dependency injection to wire in the `CredentialsManagementService` implementation identified by the qualifier 'backend'. The class is conditionally loaded only if a `CredentialsManagementService` bean is present in the Spring context.

classes.name: AutowiredCredentialsManagementAdapter
classes.description: A Spring-managed component that delegates credentials management functionality to an injected `CredentialsManagementService` implementation, conditionally enabled in the Spring context.

methods.name: setService
methods.description: Setter method for injecting the `CredentialsManagementService` bean with the qualifier `backend`.

methods.name: getService
methods.description: Overrides the superclass method to return the injected credentials management service.
